title: Record Accuracy Rate
description: The fraction of records whose facts verify against independent sources, sampled monthly. Accuracy is the network's first promise; the rate keeps the promise measured. Teaching ladder: rank 1 — the concept in its simplest, most direct form.

demo.title: Runnable code demo — Record Accuracy Rate
demo.program:
# Network-wide outcome measurement: Record Accuracy Rate
samples = [0.91, 0.87, 0.93, 0.89]  # measured values for: fact accuracy rate
method = "monthly independent sample"; target = 0.90
mean = sum(samples) / len(samples)
print("metric:", "fact accuracy rate", "via", method)
print("measured mean: %.3f  target: %.2f" % (mean, target))
print("target:", ">= 98%", "-", "MET" if mean >= target else "MISSED")

provenance: Curated from public documentation of established engineering practice; verified against standard references.
